original_test_intent: Continuously inject UPI CRC faults at approved socket/port targets, then verify the intended fatal RAS path appears in OS, BMC and recovered UEFI evidence and in specified physical indicators without leaving the platform unrecoverable.
original_method: On an isolated qualified platform, an FAE/operator applies the listed EDKII settings, provisions the supported Intel ITP/CScripts environment, verifies socket/port topology, starts the exact approved `injectUpiError` sequence for a pre-authorized bounded window, stops it through the vendor method, recovers the SUT, gathers complete Windows WHEA/ITP, BMC SEL, UEFI SEL and indicator evidence, and restores settings. The current Linux `dmesg` criterion and CPU-over-temperature LCD expectation require owner resolution rather than substitution.
manual_activity: A qualified Intel FAE/operator must enter and later restore BIOS debug settings, validate the physical socket/port, control the bounded injection and stop path, observe front-panel/LCD state, and perform recovery. The agent may only capture approved evidence around that action.
required_inputs: Exact board/CPU/UPI topology and socket-port matrix
Supported Intel ITP/CScripts package, version/hash and FAE-approved command semantics
Authorized injection duration, termination trigger and verified stop/emergency recovery path
Correct OS evidence source and expected WHEA/UPI/BMC/UEFI signatures
Front-panel and LCD applicability by SKU plus clarified LCD message
safety_requirements: Dedicated idle SUT, stable power, independent console and qualified FAE/operator
Snapshot settings and evidence before change; do not clear existing logs
Set a hard bounded injection window and explicit aborts for lost control, thermal/power anomaly, error storm, hang or no-boot
Never auto-retry or autonomously reset/power-cycle after loss of control
Restore BIOS settings only under the approved recovery sequence and preserve all fault evidence
agent_execution_scope: Verify supplied identities, hashes, approvals and baseline evidence non-mutatingly
After operator action, collect complete timestamped approved OS/BMC/UEFI artifacts without credential leakage
Do not enter BIOS, halt/resume the target, invoke ITP/CScripts, choose a socket/port, terminate an unknown injector, reset the SUT or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve hardware/firmware/OS/package compatibility and exact injection target
Resolve infinite-command duration/stop semantics and define recovery/abort limits
Correct the Windows-versus-dmesg evidence path and UPI-versus-LCD criterion
Define exact signatures, indicator behavior, restoration checks and final disposition

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its SSH grep is not the source injection procedure, assumes Linux `dmesg` despite the mandated Windows boot, suppresses most evidence with tail/grep, weakens SSH trust, and cannot prove UEFI SEL or physical indicators.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only the FAE-approved ITP/CScripts sequence may inject; agent-side commands are limited to pre-approved read-only evidence capture appropriate to the actual OS and BMC.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source `num_crcs=0`, `stopInj=False`, `cleanErrors=yes`, Socket 0~N and listed BIOS paths remain literal pending semantic approval; none is silently made safe.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed/hash-identified Intel harness and topology manifest, externally enforced injection deadline, independent console timeline, full Windows WHEA/ITP plus BMC/UEFI exports, synchronized indicator photos and explicit post-recovery setting comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds bounded control, target validation, appropriate Windows evidence, restoration and cross-plane correlation while preserving the requested infinite-CRC path.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A simple grep/SEL tail omits the injection lifecycle, recovered UEFI record and physical indicators and would not cover the original criteria.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The action can create a persistent error stream, hang or crash the SUT and expose debug settings; recovery may require hardware-owner intervention.

project_override_considerations: The approved operator/agent boundary permits evidence collection but never grants autonomous authority for BIOS unlocks, ITP fault injection, resets or recovery. Missing package inputs are readiness gates, not a DUT failure.
expected_evidence: Harness/version/hash, exact socket-port map, command transcript and bounded start/stop timeline
Pre/post BIOS setting evidence and restoration confirmation
Complete Windows WHEA/ITP or approved OS logs, BMC SEL and recovered UEFI SEL
Timestamped front-panel/LCD evidence with SKU applicability
Abort/recovery timeline, post-recovery health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure boots Windows but the Criteria require dmesg; an infinite injection is specified without duration or stop step; and an LCD CPU Over Temp message is required for a UPI CRC fault without explaining that mapping.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test remains conditionally executable because the source provides a recognizable Intel ITP/CScripts workflow. Execution is gated on the approved package, topology, bounded stop/recovery contract, operator and corrected evidence oracle; absence during a run is recorded as BLOCKED, not DUT FAIL.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 6 Wistron-System RAS-00726-V003: approve platform/CPU/UPI topology and exact Intel ITP/CScripts version/hash plus `num_crcs=0, stopInj=False, cleanErrors=yes` semantics; define a bounded injection duration, stop/emergency recovery and BIOS restoration; replace or reconcile Windows boot with dmesg evidence; specify expected WHEA/UPI/BMC/UEFI signatures and front-panel behavior; and explain/correct the LCD CPU Over Temp criterion for a UPI CRC event.

review_improvement: The review keeps the intended sustained UPI fault while closing the dangerous gap between an infinite command and a recoverable test and identifying two source-level evidence contradictions.
independent_technical_reasoning: With `stopInj=False`, the injected CRC condition may persist until a separate control path intervenes; the source never supplies that path or an upper bound. Halting and resuming through ITP also makes autonomous SSH collection unreliable precisely when the fault becomes severe. Since the SUT is explicitly booted into Windows, Linux dmesg is not a valid default oracle; WHEA/ETW or vendor output must be named. A CPU-over-temperature LCD indication is not an inherent consequence of UPI CRC injection and could signal a different fault. These are specification questions, while exact tools, topology and qualified control are readiness inputs. Therefore conditional package/user-confirmed execution is appropriate, but no injection may start until the bounded contract is approved.
